title: Ventricular Assist Devices
item_service_description:
<p><strong>A. General</strong></p>
<p>A ventricular assist device (VAD) is surgically attached to one or both intact ventricles and is used to assist or augment the ability of a damaged or weakened native heart to pump blood. Improvement in the performance of the native heart may allow the device to be removed.</p>
